subject: auto-publish-pipeline

metrics.name: Auto-publish pipeline
automation: Every new signed card → auto-publish to all 8 targets
Every root upgrade → new Merkle root + OTS proof
Every correction → corrections ledger + auto-archive superseded
verification: After publish, re-fetch from each target and verify card hash matches
Every publish produces a publish_receipt card

honest_sentence: Auto-publish pipeline: every signed card → 8 targets (board, RSS, sitemap, GitHub Pages, HF, PyPI, x402, MCP). Re-fetch + verify hash matches. Rollback + alert on mismatch. Publish_receipt card for every publish.
